tools.name: agnt_watch
tools.description: Build shell command streaming agnt daemon events via `agnt monitor`. Returns `command` for Claude Code Monitor tool or any shell runner. Filters: target (errors/interactions/process/all), proxy_id, process_id, severity, format.

target.description: Event filter: errors, interactions, process, or all (default: all)

process_id.description: Limit to one process (required when target=process)

severity.description: Minimum severity: info, warning, or error

tools.name: auth_mcp
tools.description: OAuth for MCP servers. Actions: login (start flow), logout (drop token), status (check), list (all authenticated). Returns text.

action.description: Action: login, logout, status, or list

tools.name: customize_tools
tools.description: Override tool descriptions, define custom tools. Actions: set_override, remove_override, list_overrides, define_custom, remove_custom, list_custom, export, import.

action.description: Action. Per-action args listed in slop-mcp docs.

params.description: Per-param description overrides keyed by property name (set_override)

scope.description: Scope: user, project, local. Default: user for set/define, all for remove.

stale_only.description: Only entries whose SourceHash differs from upstream (list_overrides, list_custom)

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema draft-07 subset for tool arguments (define_custom)

keys.description: Glob patterns selecting keys to export

include_custom.description: Include custom tools in export (default true)

overwrite.description: Overwrite existing keys on import (default false)

tools.name: execute_tool
tools.description: Execute tool on MCP server. Passes parameters through. Returns underlying MCP response as-is.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Metadata for connected MCPs. Compact by default (names+descriptions). verbose=true for full schemas. mcp_name+tool_name for single-tool schema.

tool_name.description: Limit to one tool (use with mcp_name)

verbose.description: Include full input schemas (default: false; always included for mcp_name+tool_name queries)

tools.name: manage_mcps
tools.description: Manage MCP connections. Actions: register, unregister, reconnect, list, status, health_check, list_stale_overrides. Returns text.

action.description: Action: register, unregister, reconnect, list, status, health_check, or list_stale_overrides

scope.description: Persistence: memory (default, runtime only), user ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/slop-mcp/config.kdl or ~/.config/slop-mcp/config.kdl), project (.slop-mcp.kdl)

dynamic.description: Always re-fetch tool list, skip cache

tools.name: run_slop
tools.description:
Execute SLOP script with access to all registered MCPs. Inline script or file path. Returns final expression value as text.

Call MCP tools as mcp_name.tool_name(param: value). Example patterns:

Chain results between tools:
  data = api.fetch(id: 42)
  summary = ai.summarize(text: data["content"])
  emit(summary)

Loop and collect:
  results = []
  for id in [1, 2, 3]:
      results = results + [api.get(id: id)]
  emit(items: results, count: len(results))

Transform with builtins:
  repos = github.search(query: "mcp")
  names = map(repos, |r| r["name"])
  emit(join(names, "\n"))

Pipe for chaining transforms (left value becomes first arg):
  [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] | filter(|x| x > 2) | map(|x| x * 10)
  data | json_stringify()

Session memory persists across run_slop calls (thread-safe):
  store_set("key", value)
  prev = store_get("key")

Persistent memory survives restarts (disk-backed):
  mem_save("bank", "key", value, description: "what this stores")
  data = mem_load("bank", "key")
  entries = mem_list("bank")
  matches = mem_search("query")

Use recipe parameter: recipe: "list" to see available templates, recipe: "<name>" to load one.
Use slop_reference to browse built-in functions (map, filter, reduce, json_parse, regex_match, etc.).

recipe.description: Embedded recipe: 'list' to enumerate, or recipe name to load

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Fuzzy search tools across connected MCPs. Ranked results. Paginated (default: 20, max: 100). Use offset for next page. Response includes total and has_more.

query.description: Search query matched against tool names and descriptions

tools.name: slop_help
tools.description: Full details for SLOP function by name. Returns formatted text.

tools.name: slop_reference
tools.description: Search SLOP built-in functions. Compact output (name+signature) by default. verbose=true for full details. list_categories=true for category counts.

category.description: Filter: math, string, list, map, random, type, json, regex, time, encoding, functional, crypto, slop

verbose.description: Include description, example, returns (default: false, compact shows name+signature)

list_categories.description: Return category counts instead of functions
